versions.content: function operator!= [SWS_CORE_00784] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 template <typename T, typename E> bool operator!= (const Result < T, E > &lhs, const T &rhs); Compare a Result instance for inequality to a value. A Result that contains no value is unequal to every value. A Result is equal to a value only if the Result contains a value of the same type, and the values compare equal.
